suite, which showed precision and recall improvements over the prior

## Accepted gaps / residual risks
| Gap | Risk | Owner | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| Only ~1 hour of production observation post-deploy | New model behavior under real traffic/edge cases not yet proven | <FILL IN> | Open — needs 24–72h soak before this baseline is considered fully validated |

| Rollback path not yet explicitly tested | If rollback is needed, unverified whether embed-v1 artifacts/infra are still warm | <FILL IN> | Open |

## Re-check / re-record triggers
Re-record a new baseline (or roll back to this one) if any of the following occur:
- Production precision/recall or downstream business metrics (CTR, conversion, etc.) regress relative to this version's eval numbers.
- `embed-v2` is upgraded, patched, or its serving config changes.
- Any incident or anomaly is traced to the embed-v1→v2 switch during the soak period.
- 72 hours pass with no anomalies — promote this from "provisionally accepted" to "fully accepted" baseline (update this file to reflect that).
- Any downstream service consuming these embeddings is found to still depend on embed-v1 assumptions (dimensionality, distribution, etc.).
